title: Sorting & Limiting Results
description: Order query results with ORDER BY (ASC, DESC) and limit row counts with LIMIT.

blocks.content:
Use `ORDER BY` to sort rows in ascending (`ASC`, default) or descending (`DESC`) order.

Use `LIMIT` to cap the number of returned rows:

```sql
SELECT name, salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 3;
```

blocks.prompt: Get the top 2 highest priced products. Return `name` and `price` ordered from highest to lowest.
blocks.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, price REAL);
blocks.answer_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 2;
